model: Saved NASA FLEX Random Forest pipeline
interpretation: At the selected input conditions, the model produces different outcome scores for Heptane and Methanol. This is a model-behavior comparison, not causal evidence or an independently validated physical prediction.
limitations: The model was fitted on all 273 eligible records.
Model scores are not calibrated physical probabilities.
This comparison uses one selected set of input conditions.
The result does not establish a general causal fuel effect.
The model is not suitable for operational fire-safety decisions.
